Koh Phangan

Do not book Haad Rin unless the party is the trip. The west and north bays are the stay.

GulfFull Moon is optional
SeasonEasier January to September
Get thereFerry from Samui or Donsak
PartyFull Moon at Haad Rin, not the whole island

Thong Nai Pan, Srithanu, and the west coast are the usual first stays. Scooter roads are steep and sandy. Grab exists in pockets; do not count on it after midnight.

Koh Tao is a further ferry if diving is the point. It is not on this first spine as a must.

Common questions

Do you need Samui as well?
One night on Samui is enough if you fly USM. Stay on Phangan if the bay is the point.
